title: Why does metabolism change with age?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: why does metabolism change with age?
evidence_strength: Moderate to established evidence supports metabolic slowdown with age primarily due to muscle loss and hormonal changes. Lifestyle interventions are evidence-based to mitigate effects but individual variability exists. Some emerging research explores molecular mechanisms but human data are limited.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
